editorial.blurb: Chicago's most iconic Peking duck destination, where tableside carving and meticulous zero-waste preparation create an unforgettable multi-course experience.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead to reserve the whole duck dinner ($70 for 3-4 people); order extra bao buns immediately—the soft, steaming pillows are essential for wrapping the impossibly crispy, tender duck, and you'll want more than the included portion.
signatureDishes: Peking Duck (with duck fried rice, bao buns, and broth)
